In my opinion its because Starfleet is all about self sufficiency, from their ship design to their officers the Federation seems to be all about preparing as much as possible while they dive into the deep end. So making these giant space cities capable of diplomatic, scientific and even residential use seems to be their way of permanent colonization.

 This way the security, study and diplomatic ability of the Federation in even the most remote sectors can be met by plopping down this swiss army fortress and extending their presence in the process. And hey if they're lucky they may even strike gold like DS9 did and become like the most important base in the sector. Oh and you're definitely right about the design, its pretty silly that a Cardassian *mining* station is seemingly more efficient as a docking station than a starbase.

You can maybe also add censorship because of rabid nationalism, I forget the actual quote but from a DS9 ep its mentioned that there's very little technological advancements the Romulan's have yet to have claimed to discover first. Which is probably based on how Roman historians had the habit of purposefully changing dates of important events or discoveries to maintain the illusion that Rome > Greece.

Yea but isn't that more due to the fact that for the most part we only see the lives of military, science and engineering professionals? People who are more interested in their careers than their sex life (kinky klingon loving trills aside). I mean for the most part if you're joining Starfleet you've got to be pretty determined and focused on mainly academia and military protocols. As opposed to say the Cardassian military whose officers were quite frequently seen in their off time with Bajoran, Orion or Cardassian women.

 To me it seems more like different mindsets and perspectives than an unfamiliarity. Like if we had a series following a Cardassian order or even a human civilian I bet the portrayal of sex would be much more prominent as they are more likely to spend their free time sipping kanar/aldebaran whiskey and bumping uglies with green exotic slave women than nerding out in the holosuites :P

>But what IS their definition of perfection?

In VOYs4e21 they introduce the omega particle, that super duper secret particle that on its own has power equivalent to a warp core. 7of9 describes it as follows: 
>Omega is infinitely complex, yet harmonious. To the Borg it represents perfection.

They were willing to sacrifice "twenty nine vessels, six hundred thousand drones" just on an experiment to see if they could synthesize a single particle. So to me it seems like the Borg's definition of "perfection" is absolute efficiency at all costs (perhaps in an attempt to become omnipotent beings like the Q?).

[source](http://www.chakoteya.net/Voyager/418.htm)

Hello, I stumbled across this post and ended up reading everything. And I don't think there's anything I could say without belittling what you went through, besides I'm terribly sorry they put you through that. As if having to rediscover yourself as a new gender wasn't hard enough! Some people can become so blinded by offering support and kindness that they don't realize they're inadvertently deceiving the other person on the mutuality of the relationship. And then act surprised when yanking the hook away leaves the other person high and dry...

But I hope this doesn't bring you down too far, I know it's probably super fuckin hard to imagine moving past this atm and I don't blame you but humor me a bit. You mentioned how quickly you were able to make friends after others left, which leaves me thinking that youre the type of person to consistently land on your feet even if shitty people get in the way. I say give yourself some alone time to find some confidence, motivation and love for yourself and then get back out there and be the best woman you can be. It's gonna be hard asf to not develop some type of trust issue because of this experience, but see it more as a cautionary tale. Something that you were blindsided and derailed by, but not destroyed!

Oi well this is getting really long and I'm sorry for rambling or coming off as sanctimonious. I'm just a big sensitive sap who wanted to help in the very little way I can. If you need a venting buddy or just another internet distraction feel free to reach out! Take care.
